programme.title: The BS computer science requires a total of 124 units for the BS computer science program
programme.degree: BS Computer Science, Department of Computer Science and Engineering
programme.how_found: web search restricted to ucsd.edu (discovery only) -> General Catalog CSE undergraduate page.
programme.notes: Owner ruling (US): no CS-specific admissions page; english, gpa, deadline, tuition and aid from admissions.ucsd.edu, students.ucsd.edu and fas.ucsd.edu, scoped to the university.

english.quote: The scores shown here are the minimum necessary to be considered for admission TOEFL minimum scores Internet-based: 4.5 (Effective January 2026) 83 (Exams completed prior to January 2026) IELTS minimum score of 7 (Academic module)
english.notes: First-year international applicants whose native language is not English and whose schooling was not in English. Duolingo English Test minimum 115; AP/IB English scores also accepted. No per-section minimums published.

value.description: Minimum A-G GPA 3.4 for non-California residents including international applicants, no grade lower than C.

gpa.quote: Non-California residents, including International applicants, must earn a GPA of 3.4 (or better) with no grade lower than a "C."
gpa.notes: UC eligibility minimum ('Competitive applicants present an academic profile stronger than the minimum requirements'). For a foreign qualification the international page asks for 'a superior average in academic subjects'; the GPA is computed on A-G-equivalent courses.

deadline.quote: October 1 - November 30 Submit Your Application Submit the University of California Application by the November 30 deadline.
deadline.notes: UC Application filing period for fall 2027 first-year entry; the same for international applicants. Printed without a year.

value.population: undergraduates first enrolled 2026-27; non-California residents (incl. international) pay Nonresident Supplemental Tuition on top

tuition.notes: Per quarter (Fall 2026, Winter 2027, Spring 2027 columns), cohort tuition for undergraduates first enrolled 2026-27, flat for up to six years. Plus Student Services Fee $462.00 and campus fees per quarter. Not summed or annualised here. 2027-28 cohort not published.

scholarship_exists.quote: The Triton Scholars Award is a renewable scholarship for incoming first-year non-resident students who demonstrate academic excellence and bring unique perspectives to the campus community. Awards range from $5,000 to $20,000 per year for up to four years of undergraduate study.
scholarship_exists.notes: PARTIAL (USD 5,000-20,000 per year), merit, competitive; automatic consideration through the UC application; must enroll full-time. International students are not eligible for federal or state aid (https://admissions.ucsd.edu/why/cost-aid/index.html).

scholarship_international.quote: The Triton Scholars Award is a renewable scholarship for incoming first-year non-resident students
scholarship_international.notes: 'non-resident' = not a California resident for tuition purposes; UCSD's own requirements page groups 'Non-California residents, including International applicants'. No sentence on the award page names international students explicitly - reviewer should confirm.
